name: policy
prompt: Implement tea/trip.py, tea/fx.py, tea/policy/rules.py, tea/policy/classify.py exactly per SPEC. tea/models.py ALREADY EXISTS with Transaction, PolicyResult, make_txn_id, TeaError, SourceError, AuthRequired, CaptchaRequired, SelectorDrift - import from it, do not redefine. Public API: trip.Trip.from_dict(d) / Trip.load(path) (json or yaml if pyyaml available), Trip.in_trip(txn)->bool, Trip.location_for(dt)->tuple[str|None,str|None], Trip.eligible_meal_day(date)->bool, Trip.nights()->int. fx.StaticFx(table: dict[tuple[str,str],Decimal]) with inverse lookup and identity; fx.FrankfurterFx(cache_dir). rules.evaluate(txns: list[Transaction], trip: Trip, fx, categories: dict[txn_id,str]) -> dict[txn_id, PolicyResult] (needs the whole list because meal caps are per-day aggregates; allocate cap in chronological order). rules.hotel_cap(city,country)->(Decimal,ccy)|None, rules.meal_cap(city,country,long_term)->(Decimal,ccy)|None. classify.classify_heuristic(txn)->str|None and classify.classify(txn, llm=None)->str where llm has complete_json(model, prompt)->dict. Refunds (amount<0) -> PASS category same, reimbursable = amount (negative), reason 'refund'. Cancelled status -> skip from result entirely. Hotel: one charge may cover multiple nights: per-night = amount / nights_in_trip_at_that_city; compare per-night with cap. Use Decimal everywhere, quantize to 0.01.

name: sources
prompt: Implement tea/sources/codef.py, tea/sources/csv_import.py, tea/sources/hanacard_web.py, and selectors/hanacard.json per SPEC. tea/models.py ALREADY EXISTS with Transaction, make_txn_id, SourceError, AuthRequired, CaptchaRequired, SelectorDrift - import from it. codef: class CodefClient(client_id, client_secret, base_url='https://api.codef.io', token_url='https://oauth.codef.io/oauth/token', http: httpx.Client|None=None, sleep=time.sleep); methods token(), fetch_approvals(connected_id, start, end, card_no=None, card_password=None)->list[dict]; function normalize_codef(row)->Transaction|None (None for rejected '3'). Overseas rows: currency from resAccountCurrency, country from resMemberStoreAddr/resNation if present else None. Timezone: domestic Asia/Seoul via zoneinfo; overseas also stamp Asia/Seoul (card system time). csv_import: load_csv(path)->list[Transaction] detecting utf-8-sig then cp949; numbers with commas; 취소여부 values '취소','부분취소','' . hanacard_web: class HanaCardWeb(selectors_path, state_path='~/.tea/hana_state.json'); methods login(page, timeout_s=300), ensure_session(page), list_transactions(page, start, end)->list[Transaction], screenshot_transaction(page, txn, out_dir)->Path. Use Playwright sync API objects passed in (do not launch browsers inside). Selector JSON keys: login_url, history_url, logged_in, session_expired, captcha, date_from, date_to, search_button, row, cells{date,time,merchant,amount,currency,amount_krw,approval_no,card_no,status,country}, next_page, next_page_disabled_attr, detail_link_template (format with approval_no), detail_panel, detail_close, mask (list of selectors). If row selector finds 0 rows and no 'empty' marker (key empty_marker) is present -> raise SelectorDrift. Write state file with os.chmod 0o600.

name: io
prompt: Implement tea/sheets.py, tea/ledger.py, tea/deel_web.py, selectors/deel.json, tea/evidence/ocr.py, tea/cli.py and tea/__main__.py per SPEC. tea/models.py ALREADY EXISTS (Transaction, PolicyResult, AuthRequired, CaptchaRequired, SelectorDrift). sheets.SheetsClient(spreadsheet_id, http: httpx.Client, token_provider: Callable[[],str], sheet_name='Ledger', sleep=time.sleep): ensure_header(), upsert(rows: list[dict])->dict(updated=int, appended=int); uses values.get A:A, values.batchUpdate for updates, values.append for new; retry 429/5xx 3x. sheets.row_for(txn, result, trip_id, city, country, screenshot_url, ocr_ok)->dict with HEADER keys, amounts as str. ledger.Ledger(path) sqlite: get(txn_id)->str|None, set(txn_id, status, ref=None) enforcing allowed transitions new->drafted->submitted, new|drafted->skipped; raises ValueError on invalid (e.g. submitted->drafted). deel_web.DeelWeb(selectors_path, ledger): prepare_expense(page, item: dict, screenshot: Path, approve=False)->str returns 'drafted'|'submitted'|'skipped-duplicate'|'skipped-fail'; item has txn_id, category, amount, currency, date (YYYY-MM-DD), merchant, trip_id, policy_status, policy_reason. Never submit if policy_status=='FAIL'. If ledger says submitted -> 'skipped-duplicate' without touching page. Detect session_expired selector -> AuthRequired. selectors/deel.json keys: expenses_url, add_expense, category_select, category_option_template, amount, currency_select, currency_option_template, date, description, file_input, save_draft, submit, confirmation_ref, session_expired, form_error. ocr.ocr_check(png_path, txn, client)->dict where client.ocr(image_bytes)->str (markdown); include MistralOcrClient(api_key, http) calling POST https://api.mistral.ai/v1/ocr with model 'mistral-ocr-latest' and document {type:'image_url', image_url:'data:image/png;base64,...'}, returns joined pages[].markdown. Amount matching: normalize by removing commas/currency symbols, accept 1234.50 vs 1,234.5. cli: argparse subcommands run/deel/login as SPEC; deel --approve requires typing 'yes' at prompt (input()).
